description: Creates a hosted Stripe (credit-card) checkout link for a prepared booking — an alternative consumer payment rail to `create_checkout` (Revolut). Required: `bookingId` (the `preparedBookingId` from `prepare_booking`), `currency` (3-letter), and `backUrl`; optional `successUrl`. REQUIRES A REGISTERED-ACCOUNT SESSION; a `guest_login` session is REJECTED here (the Stripe rail is not open to guests; use `create_checkout` for a guest instead). Returns a payment `url` and a `sessionId`. Share the `url` with the guest — the booking is confirmed automatically by webhook once payment succeeds. Prefer `create_checkout` unless a Stripe card link is specifically needed.

successUrl.description: Custom URL to redirect on success
